entries.headline: Six transports and weather reconnaissance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six military transport aircraft over the United States and North Sea and a US Air Force weather-reconnaissance aircraft over Alaska. The visible post is truncated after “Five coded radio broadcasts heard earlier…”.

entries.headline: US transports, weather reconnaissance and Russian cargo aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft over the United States, a nuclear-capable weather-reconnaissance aircraft near Alaska and a Russian cargo aircraft south of Cyprus heading from Syria.

entries.headline: Six US transports, weather reconnaissance and no coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft across the Atlantic and over the North Sea, a weather-reconnaissance aircraft over Alaska and no coded radio broadcasts during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Five US transports, weather reconnaissance and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft over the North Sea and United States, a weather-reconnaissance aircraft over Alaska and five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: Six US transports and surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft, including one over the North Sea and another near Korea and Japan, plus a US Air Force surveillance aircraft near Alaska. The visible post is truncated after “Five coded US Air…”.

entries.headline: Six US transports and coded radio traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, including one over the North Sea, with coded radio traffic detected and activity above its stated normal level.

entries.headline: Five US transports and earlier coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea, with no coded radio broadcasts during the preceding hour and five detected earlier in the day.

entries.headline: Six US transports and five earlier coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and elsewhere, with five coded radio broadcasts earlier in the day and activity at its stated normal level.

entries.headline: Six US transports over the North Sea and United States reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea and another over the continental United States, with five coded radio broadcasts earlier in the day.

entries.headline: Six US transports, command aircraft and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft over or near US territory and Europe, a nuclear command aircraft airborne and five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report of Riyadh flight cancellations
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a BBC report that multiple major airlines had cancelled flights to Riyadh after Houthi attacks, crediting @alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Six US transports and four coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, four coded radio broadcasts earlier in the day and activity above its stated normal baseline.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: B737 on-ground alert at Al Muharraq
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a US-registered military Boeing 737 at Al Muharraq, Bahrain. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Covelong
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military P-8 aircraft at Covelong, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Turkish interceptor-drone demonstration
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Turkish defence company ASELSAN demonstrated its GÖKALP interceptor drone destroying a target drone by direct impact.

entries.headline: B737 CNV5450 on-ground alert at Al Muharraq
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for US-registered military Boeing 737 CNV5450 at Al Muharraq, Bahrain.

entries.headline: B737 CNV5450 airborne alert at Mulayjah
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for US-registered military B737 aircraft CNV5450 at Mulayjah, Saudi Arabia.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Super Hornet weapons-computer support
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that the weapons computer used by US Navy F/A-18 and EA-18G aircraft could no longer be supported because of obsolescence and component shortages.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Springs
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military aircraft labelled E6 at Springs, United States. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Perumbakkam
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a military P-8 aircraft at Perumbakkam, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 on-ground alert at Misawa
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for an Australian-registered military P-8 aircraft at Misawa, Japan. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 on-ground alert at Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for an Australian-registered military P-8 aircraft at Darwin, Australia. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 BLKT06 on-ground alert at Mount Louisa
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Australian-registered military P-8 aircraft BLKT06 at Mount Louisa, Australia.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Thai queen’s solo Gripen flight
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that Queen Suthida of Thailand completed a solo flight in a JAS 39C Gripen.
